strings.advisor.title: Bulbul, Visit Al-Ahsa danışmanı
strings.advisor.intro:
Hoş geldiniz, sefalar getirdiniz! 🐦🌴
Ben Bulbul, El-Ahsa'nın her hurma ağacını tanırım.
Sadece gezinmeye mi geldiniz, yoksa buralılardan başkasının bilmediği yerlerin peşinde misiniz? Nelerden hoşlandığınızı söyleyin, keyfinize göre bir gezi ayarlayayım.
strings.advisor.notice: Yalnızca sitenin içeriğinden yanıt verir. Sorular Anthropic'in hizmeti üzerinden işlenir ve saklanmaz.
strings.advisor.resting: Bulbul şu an dinleniyor. Gezilecek yerlere ya da “Gezinizi planlayın” sayfasına göz atabilirsiniz.
strings.advisor.rate: Bugünkü soru sınırına ulaştınız. Yarın görüşmek üzere; bu arada gezilecek yerlerin sayfaları emrinizde.
strings.advisor.error: Bulbul'a ulaşılamadı. Lütfen birazdan yeniden deneyin.
strings.advisor.chip2: Cebel el-Kare'nin ziyaret saatleri ve giriş ücretleri nedir?

source_defects: advisor.chip3 en 'Hasawi food' deviates from ar 'المطبخ الأحسائي' (en should be 'Al-Ahsa cuisine'); tr follows ar + nav.food 'El-Ahsa mutfağı'.
advisor.intro en 'Hala!' is weaker than the ar hearty Gulf welcome 'يا هلا والله!'; tr follows ar.
notes: [s1] Bulbul'a/Bulbul'un per termbase 'Bulbul' (Latin brand, not Bülbül). 'Bulbul'a sorun' = 14 chars with the apostrophe.

[s1] Jabal Al-Qarah = 'Cebel el-Kare' (termbase/tm), suffix 'Cebel el-Kare'nin'; 'giriş ücretleri' per tm. Page labels verbatim from ui.tr: 'Gezinizi planlayın' in “…”, 'Gezilecek yerler' (resting says 'Gezilecek yerlere'; rate says 'gezilecek yerler sayfaları').
[s1] intro line 2 'palm by palm' rendered as 'her hurma ağacını tanırım' (idiom 'karış karış' would lose the palm image). Line 3 'طلعة' rendered 'gezi'. All siz forms. Anthropic'in: last vowel i.
[s1] Apostrophe is straight ' (as in tm 'Cebel el-Kare'de'); P8 not re-decided.
[s2] Stage-1 draft was already clean Turkish UI; edits are limited to the intro (warmer greeting, 'buralıların', no double 'size'), resting/rate (smoother phrasing, label forms kept), chip3 (verb).

[s2] Kept unchanged: open, title, placeholder, send, close, notice, error, cards, chip1, chip2, thinking, reset. 'Bulbul'a sorun' stays at 14 chars. Apostrophes all U+0027 (P8). No bureaucratic -mektedir chains; no sen.

[s3] Localizer pass: UI labels and a persona greeting carry no heat, season, hours, family or logistics emphasis in the source, and adding any would be a new fact (fence). All 16 strings left exactly as stage 2; no fact touched, nothing glossed (El-Ahsa, Cebel el-Kare and the page labels are already the published forms; Hicri/UNESCO/hours absent).

[s4] Fact fence against ar (authority) and en, key by key: no fact, number, promise, tip or colour found that the sources lack; nothing deleted (facts_removed empty). notice checked word by word: 'only from site content' = ar 'من محتوى الموقع فقط' / en 'from this site's content only'; 'processed through Anthropic's service' = ar 'عبر خدمة Anthropic' ('üzerinden'); 'not stored' = ar 'ولا تُحفظ' ('saklanmaz', retention sense, not 'recorded'); nothing strengthened, softened or added; Anthropic'in = Latin name read 'Antropik', last vowel i.

[s4] Translation smell: one fix only, the intro line 3 echo 'Sadece … yalnızca' (two 'only' words in one sentence); the second is now carried by 'buralılardan başkasının bilmediği' = ar 'ما يعرفها إلا أهل الديرة' (no one but the locals knows), so the 'only locals' fact is kept exactly. No -mektedir chain, no stacked olan, no calqued case government found; 'göz atmak' takes the dative on both targets; chip2 'ziyaret saatleri … nedir?' is the tm-attested question shape (Cebel el-Kare'nin ziyaret saatleri nedir?).

[s4] Assessment, greeting 'Hoş geldiniz, sefalar getirdiniz!' for ar 'يا هلا والله!': kept. It is the stock Turkish hosting welcome and the nearest register match for the hearty Gulf formula (en 'Hala!' and a bare 'Hoş geldiniz!' are both flatter). 'sefa' is the idiom's own warmth, not a fact or a promise; one '!' as in the source; siz. Raised to the judge as a register choice (fallback 'Hoş geldiniz!'), not settled silently.

[s4] Assessment, 'her hurma ağacını tanırım' for ar 'أعرف الأحساء نخلة نخلة' / en 'palm by palm': kept. It is the same playful hyperbole as the source, not a new claim, and matches the published ru/ur lines (every palm); the Turkish idiom 'karış karış' would drop the palm image the source keeps. Raised to the judge as an alternative ('El-Ahsa'yı karış karış bilirim').

[s4] open_items P6/P7/P11/P12 not touched by these strings; calibration P1 (El-Ahsa, Cebel el-Kare), P3 (Cebel, no 'Dağı'), P4, P8 (U+0027), P5 respected; no new proper name, termbase_additions empty. Persona name 'Bulbul' used exactly as the termbase entry; no objection to raise, not 'Bülbül', and 'Bulbul'a sorun' = 14 chars, at the brief's limit.

[s5] Mechanical proofread, eleven items, no change to any string (strings identical to tr-04). Letters: no ASCII-stripped word; no i/İ or ı/I case error (the only capital İ is in 'İlgili', written with U+0130). Suffixes: Bulbul'a, El-Ahsa'nın, Cebel el-Kare'nin, Anthropic'in all follow the termbase suffix vowel, single apostrophe U+0027, none on a common noun; the question particle is written apart ('gezinmeye mi', 'peşinde misiniz'). Address: siz forms only, no sen. Punctuation: ellipsis U+2026 as in the published ui.tr ('Sorunuzu yazın…', 'Gezilecek yer arayın…'), quotes “…” only (no « » or straight "), no U+00A0, no space before .,;!?, no final full stop issue (labels carry none). Numbers: no digits in the 16 strings. Intro keeps exactly two \n and the two emoji at the end of line 1.
[s5] advisor.open = 14 characters (apostrophe counted), within the brief's target of at most 14.
